text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and your mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, regular exercise keeps you strong and gives you more energy. Third, don't forget sleep: most adults need about seven to eight hours every night to feel their best. Mental health is just as important as physical health, so take time to relax and talk to friends when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance, because spending time on hobbies and with family helps you stay happy and healthy.
